title: Flows
subtitle: Multi-step automations that chain tools together.

empty.title: No flows yet
empty.body: Ask Breeze AI to draft a flow, then review it here.

pausedReason.drift: Paused because the flow changed after it was enabled.
pausedReason.binding_drift: Paused because a pre-approved script or target changed.
pausedReason.delegator_inactive: Paused because the person it runs on behalf of is no longer active.
pausedReason.org_merged: Paused because the organization was merged.
pausedReason.event_dispatch_not_durable: Paused because event delivery is not durable on this server.

enable.title: Enable flow
enable.body: Enabling publishes this version of the flow. It then runs on its trigger. Steps that need approval still ask for it unless you pre-approve them below.
enable.preApproveHelp: Runs of this version skip the approval prompt for this step. Pre-approval covers exactly the script and target shown here and stops applying if the flow changes.

notEligible.not_tier3: Only steps that need approval can be pre-approved.
notEligible.script_not_literal: The script is chosen at run time, so it cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.run_context_not_literal: The run-as setting is chosen at run time, so it cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.group_target: This step targets a device group, which can change. Pre-approval needs fixed devices.
notEligible.variable_dependent: This step depends on values that are only known at run time.
notEligible.script_not_found: The script this step uses could not be found.
notEligible.four_eyes: This action always needs a second person to approve it.
notEligible.tenant_tool: Custom tool sources cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.for_each: Steps that repeat for each item cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.run_as_elevated: This script runs elevated, so it cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.selector_not_literal: The devices are chosen at run time, so this step cannot be pre-approved.
notEligible.max_targets_invalid: Set how many devices this step may run on (1–500) to pre-approve it.

enable.eventScope: Event flows react to platform events whatever caused them, including actions taken by people, other flows, or automations. Check the trigger filter before you enable it.
enable.missingPermissions: You are missing permissions that this flow's steps need:
enable.eventNotDurable: Event delivery is not durable on this server, so event flows cannot be enabled right now.
enable.forEachConcurrency: Steps that repeat for each item run one item at a time.
enable.noTier3: No step in this flow needs approval.
enable.validationFailed: The flow has validation errors. Fix them before enabling:
enable.versionConflict: The flow changed since you opened this page. Reload it and review the changes before enabling.
enable.foreachConcurrencyNotAvailable: This flow repeats a step for each item in parallel, which this server does not support yet.
enable.delegationScopeRestricted: Your access is limited to some sites, so you cannot enable a flow that runs across the whole organization.
enable.partnerWideForbidden: You do not have permission to enable flows for all organizations.
enable.interactiveRequired: Flows can only be enabled from a signed-in browser session.
enable.slugUnavailable: Another flow in this scope already uses this identifier.
enable.webhookSecretMissing: Create a webhook secret before you enable this flow.
enable.aiBudgetUnavailable: This organization has no AI budget to spend, so a flow with an AI step cannot be enabled.
enable.webhookSecretInvalidated: Enabling this version cleared the webhook secret, because the secret was created for an older draft. Every request is refused until you create a new secret and give it to the sender.

run.title: Run flow
run.queueFull: This flow has too many runs waiting. Try again once some have finished.
run.permissionMissing: You do not have permission to run the steps of this flow: {{permissions}}
run.preApprovalsNotHonored: This run was started by someone without approval rights, so pre-approvals were not applied and each step asks for approval.
run.orgRequired: Choose the organization to run this flow in.
run.notEnabled: This flow is not enabled, so it cannot be run.
run.delegationScopeRestricted: Your access is limited to some sites, so you cannot run a flow that works across the whole organization.
run.interactiveUserRequired: Only a signed-in person can start a manual run. Sign in to the web app and try again.
run.orgForbidden: You do not have access to that organization.
run.notManual: This flow does not run manually. It starts from its trigger.

runDetail.title: Flow run
runDetail.awaitingApproval: This run is paused until someone approves a step.

error.drift: The flow changed after it was enabled, so the run was stopped.
error.binding_drift: A pre-approved script or target changed, so the run was stopped.
error.unknown_outcome: The result of a step is unknown. The step may have run. Check the device by hand before running the flow again.
error.step_timeout: A step took too long and was stopped.
error.input_invalid: A step received input it could not use.
error.reference_not_owned: A step referred to something that belongs to another organization.
error.tool_unavailable: A tool used by this flow is no longer available.
error.tool_blocked: A tool used by this flow is blocked.
error.too_many_items: A step would have repeated for more items than allowed.
error.render_failed: A step's input could not be built from earlier results.
error.no_eligible_approvers: No one is able to approve a step that needs approval.
error.worker_lost: The run was interrupted and could not continue.
error.run_timeout: The run took longer than the one-hour limit and was stopped.
error.flow_disabled: The flow was disabled while this run was active.
error.flows_disabled: Flows are turned off on this server.
error.delegator_inactive: The person this run acts for is no longer active.
error.org_merged: The organization was merged into another one.
error.egress_blocked: The outbound request was blocked by the egress policy.
error.http_status: The outside API answered with an error status.
error.notify_failed: The notice could not be sent.
error.ai_budget_exhausted: The organization's AI budget is used up.
error.ai_output_invalid: The AI result did not match the expected shape.
error.ai_token_cap_reached: The run reached its AI token limit.
error.targets_over_cap: The step targeted more devices than a flow step may run on (500).
error.targets_unresolvable: The step's device target could not be resolved.
error.alert_create_failed: The alert could not be created.
error.script_dispatch_failed: The script could not be sent to one or more devices.

step.truncated: Output was shortened because it was too large.
step.pruned: Details were removed by the retention policy.
step.redacted: Step details aren't available with your access.

runDetail.queuedNote: Queued. Waiting for a free run slot.
runDetail.agentRun: Started by an AI agent run

disable.title: Disable flow
disable.message: Disabling stops new runs and cancels runs that are in progress. You can enable the flow again later.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the value and copy it by hand.

authHelp.hmac: The sender signs each request with the secret. Breeze refuses requests that are unsigned, wrongly signed or more than five minutes old, and runs a replayed request only once.
authHelp.token: The sender puts the secret itself in a header. This is weaker than signing: anyone who sees one request can send more. Use it only for senders that cannot sign.

signing.title: How to send a request
signing.hmac: Send a JSON object as the body. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over <timestamp>.<raw body> with the secret, and send these headers:
signing.token: Send a JSON object as the body, with the secret in this header:
signing.deliveryId: Optional: send a unique {{header}} so a retry of the same delivery runs only once.

secret.label: Secret
secret.none: No secret yet. Every request is refused until you create one.
secret.warning: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
secret.rotateMessage: The current secret stops working immediately. The sender gets refused until it uses the new secret.
secret.failed: Could not create the webhook secret.
secret.draftUnresolvable: The draft's steps no longer resolve, so a secret cannot be created for it. Fix the draft first.
secret.notWebhook: This flow is not started by a webhook.

lastFailure.label: Last refused request
lastFailure.stale_timestamp: The timestamp was missing or more than five minutes off.
lastFailure.bad_token: The secret in the header was wrong.
lastFailure.bad_delivery_id: The delivery ID was not valid.

orgResolver.label: Organization
orgResolver.externalId: Matched by {{path}} against external IDs of type {{system}}
orgResolver.breezeOrgId: Read from {{path}} as a Breeze organization ID

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.hidden: Delivery IDs and organization values are hidden with your access.

usage.title: Runs this month

refused.flow_monthly_cap_reached: This flow reached its monthly run limit.
refused.owner_monthly_cap_reached: The owner reached its monthly run limit for all flows.

usage.refusedBanner: Runs are being refused. {{reason}} Last refused {{time}}. The flow stays enabled and runs again when the month resets or the limit is raised.

limits.title: Flow limits
limits.subtitle: Monthly run limits and the AI token limit for each run. Set a default for your partner, and lower it for an organization when needed.

monthlyRunsPerOwner.label: Runs per month, all flows
monthlyRunsPerOwner.help: The most runs all flows of one owner can start in a calendar month (UTC).

monthlyRunsPerFlow.label: Runs per month, per flow
monthlyRunsPerFlow.help: The most runs one flow can start in a calendar month (UTC). A flow can set a lower limit of its own.

aiTokensPerRun.label: AI tokens per run
aiTokensPerRun.help: The most AI tokens the AI steps of one run can use.

limits.ceilingNote: Organizations can only lower this. The partner value is {{value}}.
limits.aboveCeiling: The stored value {{value}} is above the partner value, so it does not apply.
limits.aboveCeilingError: Must be {{value}} or lower (the partner value).
limits.range: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
limits.saveFailed: Could not save the flow limits.
limits.loadFailed: Could not load the flow limits.
limits.orgNotFound: This organization was not found or you no longer have access to it.
limits.readOnly: You can view these limits but not change them.
limits.partnerWideForbidden: Changing the partner default needs access to all organizations.
limits.orgScopeReadOnly: Organization limits are set by your service provider.

conversion.noFindings: Nothing to review: this job moves exactly.

flows_disabled.title: Flows are off here
flows_disabled.line: This installation runs with FLOWS_ENABLED=false, so jobs stay as they are.

managed_row.title: Managed by Breeze
managed_row.line: An AI agent or a monitor owns this job; it moves with its owner, not on its own.

policy_workflow.title: Part of a policy workflow
policy_workflow.line: Configuration policies run this job; it moves when policy workflows move.

already_retired.title: Already turned off
already_retired.line: This job was retired and no longer runs.

compliance_remediation_target.title: Used for compliance remediation
compliance_remediation_target.line: A compliance policy runs this job to fix devices; it stays a job for now.

event_dispatch_not_durable.title: Event delivery isn't durable here
event_dispatch_not_durable.line: Event jobs move only with EVENT_DISPATCH_MODE=enforce and flow-event-trigger subscribed.

event_filter_not_strict.title: Event filter can't be copied exactly
event_filter_not_strict.line: The filter uses lists, objects, too many keys or a key flows can't match.

event_filter_null.title: Event filter checks for empty values
event_filter_null.line: Jobs tell an empty value from a missing one; flows can't.

cron_semantics_differ.title: Schedule would fire at different times
cron_semantics_differ.line: This cron expression doesn't match the flow scheduler across daylight-saving changes.

condition_unknown_type.title: Unknown target condition
condition_unknown_type.line: A condition type the job runner ignores; a flow can't copy it safely.

targets_over_cap.title: Too many devices
targets_over_cap.line: This job targets more than 400 devices; a flow step runs at most 500.

partner_wide_group_target.title: All-orgs job targets groups
partner_wide_group_target.line: Device groups belong to one organization, so an all-orgs job can't target them.

run_as_elevated.title: Runs elevated
run_as_elevated.line: A moved script never runs elevated without someone watching.

restart_service_monitor_only.title: Restarts a service
restart_service_monitor_only.line: Service restarts only run from monitors.

command_mixed_os.title: Command without a shell on mixed devices
command_mixed_os.line: Pick a shell, or narrow the targets to one operating system.

notify_per_run_cap.title: Too many notifications per run
notify_per_run_cap.line: Flows send at most 20 notifications per run.

channel_type_not_supported.title: Notification channel not supported
channel_type_not_supported.line: A flow can't send to this channel type yet.

deploy_software_unmapped.title: Deploys software
deploy_software_unmapped.line: Software deployment doesn't move to Flows yet.

monthly_cap_exceeded.title: Runs more often than the monthly limit
monthly_cap_exceeded.line: The estimated monthly runs are above this owner's flow limit.

reference_not_owned.title: Uses something this owner doesn't own
reference_not_owned.line: A script, channel or group belongs to a different owner.

partner_wide_webhook.title: All-orgs webhook job
partner_wide_webhook.line: A flow webhook needs one organization to run in.

text_template_unsupported.title: Text contains template braces
text_template_unsupported.line: A flow would read double braces in the text as a template.

event_filter_string_coercion.title: Text filter value
event_filter_string_coercion.line: Jobs compare as text, flows compare exactly; confirm the field is always text.

approval_each_run.title: Approval on every webhook run
approval_each_run.line: Pre-approval never applies to webhook runs, so each run waits for a person.

command_becomes_script.title: Command becomes a script
command_becomes_script.line: The command is saved as a library script you review before switching.

partner_wide_org_set_differs.title: Runs once per organization
partner_wide_org_set_differs.line: A flow skips suspended organizations and runs in at most 500 of them.

failure_notice_cap.title: Failure notices may be capped
failure_notice_cap.line: More than 20 failure notices in one run are not sent.

owner_cap_pressure.title: Close to the monthly limit
owner_cap_pressure.line: This flow would use more than 80% of the owner's monthly runs.

site_ceiling_removed.title: Wider device scope
site_ceiling_removed.line: The job was limited to its creator's sites; the flow is not.

webhook_body_shape.title: Webhook body must be a JSON object
webhook_body_shape.line: The flow ignores deliveries that aren't JSON objects.

legacy_secret_header_possible.title: Plain secret header
legacy_secret_header_possible.line: Senders that send the plain secret must switch to X-Breeze-Webhook-Token.

name_truncated.title: Name shortened
name_truncated.line: Flow names are at most 120 characters.

duration_minutes_ignored.title: Duration ignored
duration_minutes_ignored.line: The event duration setting never had an effect and is dropped.

schedule_outage_catch_up.title: Catches up after an outage
schedule_outage_catch_up.line: After downtime the flow runs the latest missed time once; the job ran none.

queued_is_success.title: Queued counts as done
queued_is_success.line: As before, a script queued for an offline device counts as dispatched.

severity_mapped.title: Severity mapped
severity_mapped.line: High and medium become warning; low and info become info.

notification_emails_unused.title: Email list dropped
notification_emails_unused.line: The job's email list was never used and is dropped.

webhook_url_changes.title: Webhook address
webhook_url_changes.line: Senders keep the old address; it forwards to the flow.

delegator_pause.title: Pauses if you lose access
delegator_pause.line: The flow runs as you and pauses if your account is turned off or narrowed.

panel.title: Move "{{name}}" to Flows
panel.subtitle: See what carries over, watch the flow shadow the job, then switch.
panel.switchedNote: The flow runs this job now. The job is read-only until you move it back.

shadow.heading: Shadow
shadow.explain: The flow checks each run of the job without running anything.

divergence.trigger_mismatch: Last difference: the flow and the job disagreed on whether to run.
divergence.target_set_mismatch: Last difference: the flow would have picked different devices.
divergence.would_park: Last difference: a step would have waited for approval.
divergence.over_cap: Last difference: the run would have hit a flow limit.

switch.title: Switch "{{name}}" to its flow
switch.body: From one minute after you switch, the flow runs every occurrence and the job stops. Nothing runs twice.

blocked.shadow_too_new: Switch opens once the shadow is 10 minutes old.
blocked.shadow_too_short: The shadow has checked fewer than 3 runs or is under 7 days old.
blocked.shadow_divergent: The shadow saw differences between the flow and the job.
blocked.source_changed: The job changed since it was converted. Start a new shadow.

switch.acknowledge: Switch anyway; I accept the evidence shown.
switch.preApprovalsHelp: Off by default. Without it, each run of a script step waits for a person to approve it.
switch.noPreApprovals: No script step can run without approval.
switch.maxTargetsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
switch.liveMembership: Devices are worked out fresh on each run. Anyone who can change a group's members can change where this runs; a run above the limit pauses the flow.
switch.frozenDevices: If a run waits for approval, the approver sees the exact devices and only those run.
switch.perOrgMultiplies: This is an all-orgs flow: the limit applies in each organization, so the total can be this many times the number of organizations.
switch.webhookApprovalEachRun: Webhook runs always wait for approval, even with pre-approval.
switch.generatedScriptsHelp: Each command becomes a library script owned like the job.
switch.acceptScopeWidening: I accept that the flow is not limited to the job creator's sites.
switch.webhookChange: Senders keep the old webhook address; it forwards to the flow. The flow accepts JSON objects only, and senders of the plain secret must use X-Breeze-Webhook-Token.
switch.acceptDelegatorLifecycle: The flow runs as me. If my account is turned off or loses access, the flow pauses (the job did not).

revert.title: Move "{{name}}" back to the job?
revert.body: The job turns on again and the flow starts nothing new. Runs already started on the flow finish.

toast.switched: Switched. The flow runs this job from now on.
toast.reverted: Moved back. The job runs again.

errors.conversion_exists: This job is already being moved.
errors.source_changed: The job changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
errors.partner_wide_forbidden: Moving all-orgs jobs needs full partner access.
errors.interactive_session_required: Sign in as a person to do this.
errors.delegation_scope_restricted: Your access is limited to some sites, so you can't switch or move back.
errors.not_shadow: Only a job in shadow can switch.
errors.not_switched: Only a switched job can move back.
errors.version_conflict: The flow changed. Reload and try again.
errors.slug_unavailable: Another flow already uses this name.
errors.shadow_too_new: Switch opens once the shadow is 10 minutes old.
errors.shadow_too_short: Not enough shadow evidence yet. Acknowledge it to switch anyway.
errors.shadow_divergent: The shadow saw differences. Acknowledge them to switch anyway.
errors.scope_widening_not_accepted: Accept the wider device scope to switch.
errors.automation_disabled: Turn the job on before you switch it.
errors.automation_converted: This job moved to Flows. Change it there.
errors.automations_moved_to_flows: New jobs are made in Flows.
errors.flow_not_found: The job's flow no longer exists.
errors.revert_closed: Moving back is closed on this installation.
errors.generated_script_rejected: A script for this job couldn't be created.
errors.permission_missing: You don't have every permission the flow needs.
errors.event_dispatch_not_durable: Event delivery here is not durable.

banner.r1Body: New jobs are made in Flows. Move each job when its shadow matches; you can move it back.
